conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Harbor Street Patients.
